title: Find Resultant Array After Removing Anagrams
description: Remove consecutive anagrams from an array of strings.
pseudocode:
1. result = [words[0]]
2. for i from 1 to words.length - 1:
3.   if sorted(words[i]) != sorted(result.last):
4.     result.append(words[i])
5. return result

steps.note: Initialize result with the first word.
Compare words[1] ('baba') with result.last ('abba'). They are anagrams, skip.
Compare words[2] ('bbaa') with result.last ('abba'). They are anagrams, skip.
Compare words[3] ('cd') with result.last ('abba'). Not anagrams, add to result.
Compare words[4] ('cd') with result.last ('cd'). They are anagrams, skip.
